title: Nuevo Laredo Delivers $8.9 Million in Paving and Street Lighting
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo delivered paving and public lighting projects worth 8.9 million pesos across four colonias, adding 1,354 meters of new lighting and more than 2,300 square meters of asphalt.
content:
The Government of Nuevo Laredo delivered paving and public lighting projects worth 8.9 million pesos across four colonias, Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal announced Monday, according to Portal Tamaulipas.

Together, the projects add 1,354 linear meters of new lighting and more than 2,300 square meters of asphalt paving, along with rehabilitated water and sewer lines, sidewalks, curbs and signage. The four areas are San Roberto, Ejido La Unión, 150 Aniversario and Vamos Tamaulipas.

On Radial 3, serving San Roberto and Ejido La Unión, the city spent 3 million pesos to light the stretch between Carretera Aeropuerto and Rotonda El Conejo — a key freight route to the World Trade Bridge — with 40 poles and 40 LED lights over 1,354 meters. In 150 Aniversario, 3.9 million pesos paved more than 1,370 square meters on Evarista Guerra and Irineo Escamilla, and in Vamos Tamaulipas, close to 2 million pesos paved more than 926 square meters on Lagos de Moreno.

Leslie del Ángel, a resident of 150 Aniversario, thanked the city, saying the paved street helps families get their children to school more safely. The mayor said the city renews underground infrastructure before laying new asphalt so the work lasts.

Sources: Portal Tamaulipas, Nov. 24, 2026.
